ops.title: Sprite lane's store-desk read times out though the Mac answers in 1 s
ops.premise: Premise: lr's RunOnMac on a Sprite never sees the store desk's answer because it follows the lane's stem while the answer is addressed to the numbered lane. Cases: ask 977@38789d56 (Mac 542840) answered 542841 in 1.2 s, blocker 1020@38789d56 at 45 s; ask 1128@471908cb (542998) answered 542999 in 0.95 s, blocker 1156@471908cb at 45 s.
